decisions.statement: A percent past a hundred is refused rather than sent to Spotify.
A call naming no percent is refused rather than reading the loudness back.
A device named on the command line is set rather than the active device.
A call saying `--json` is answered one line of JSON, and one saying nothing words.
The set is handed in, so no test of it reaches Spotify.

definition: the command setting how loud a Spotify device plays
